name: port
label: Listening port
description: Actual UDP listening port passed as -port. Restart required.

name: publiclobby
label: Community server listing
description: Adds -publiclobby so the server appears as a community server.

name: publicip
label: Public IP override
description: Public IP passed as -publicip for community-server advertising. Leave empty for automatic detection.

name: publicport
label: Public port override
description: Advertised port passed as -publicport. This does not change the actual listening port.

name: useperfthreads
label: Use performance threads
description: Adds the legacy -useperfthreads flag. Pocketpair notes that omitting legacy performance flags may improve performance from version 1.0 onward.

name: numberOfWorkerThreadsServer
label: Worker thread count
description: Value for -NumberOfWorkerThreadsServer. Leave empty to let PalServer decide.
